verdict: A quiet day: one real pipeline-relevant item (Blender 5.3 with Gaussian splatting support) plus a MiniMax-H3 ComfyUI update, surrounded by academic paper noise, festival listings, and trade-press filler worth skipping.

stories.headline: Blender 5.3 adds native 3D Gaussian Splatting and DLSS denoising
stories.body: Blender 5.3 ships with built-in 3D Gaussian Splatting support, DLSS-based denoising, and a layered compositing system, according to CG Channel's feature rundown. This puts splat import/editing directly into a free, open-source DCC rather than requiring third-party plugins, and brings GPU denoising parity with commercial renderers. No pricing or licence change since Blender remains GPL.
stories.why: Splatting support inside Blender lowers the barrier to bringing Gaussian scenes into existing asset pipelines.

stories.headline: MiniMax-H3 long-video ComfyUI build updated with LoRA sliders
stories.body: The community MiniMax-H3-Longvideos repo on Hugging Face has been updated, bundling ComfyUI nodes and LoRA-based speed/detail sliders for the MiniMax-H3 video model. It carries a non-standard licence (listed as 'other'), has seen 683 downloads, and is tagged for long-form text-to-video with audio. Usable today by anyone running ComfyUI with the right hardware, but licence terms need checking before client work.
stories.why: A deployable ComfyUI workflow for long-form video generation, but licence terms still need clearing for commercial use.
